caption: The drawing depicts a single high-buttoned boot prominently in the foreground, shown in a realistic, shaded style. The boot is rendered in shades of dark brown and black, with a medium-high heel and a pointed toe. It features a row of buttons along the outer side, and stitching details are visible on the upper part. To the left, there are two simple outline sketches in pencil. These outlines show the boot from a top-down perspective and a side view focusing on the button area and overall shape, but without shaded details or color. The background of the paper is an off-white or beige color, and the artist's name, CHARLES GARJAN, is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Woman's Shoe
